title: Firewall parity hardening batch (F-01/F-02/F-03/F-05 depth + remote-group mapping)
acceptance_criteria: IPv4/IPv6 firewall batch endpoints enforce protocol/action semantic coupling with deterministic 400 errors.
IPv4/IPv6 firewall reorder paths preserve GeoIP and mac/domain/remote group leaves.
Frontend firewall rule API mappers emit remote-group source/destination operations for create/update.
Firewall groups batch rejects conflicting set/delete member operations and multiple remote URL values.
Flowtables batch rejects duplicate interface entries and conflicting offload selections.
Validation gates pass: targeted backend pytest, frontend tsc/eslint, build, runtime smoke, UI smoke.
assumptions: This slice advances but does not fully complete F-01/F-02/F-03/F-05 parity items.
Global options parity item F-04 is unchanged in this cycle.

tasks.notes: Added semantic batch validation and expanded reorder handling for advanced source/destination fields.
Added batch consistency guardrails for groups and flowtables.
Added remote-group source/destination mapping for create and update operations.
Added regression coverage for new semantic/batch consistency validations and reorder parity.
Continue remaining firewall partial backlog items (including F-04/F-06 depth and live verification).
